info.title: UltraKIL Scheduling API
info.description:
Phase 1 pilot API for UltraKIL scheduling and dispatching.

Hard rules enforced by this API:
- Colombo staff serve Colombo work only; Kandy staff serve Kandy work only.
- Permanently stationed staff are never moved away from their site.
- Every job carries at least one PMS-grade supervisor.
- A vehicle may only be driven by an employee authorised for it.
- Allowed service days are hard constraints; preferred days are preferences.

Work that cannot satisfy every hard rule stays in the Unassigned queue
with an explanation. Hard rules are never relaxed to fill a schedule.

Errors always carry a stable `code`. Clients must branch on `code`,
never on `message`.

Every endpoint requires a bearer token except sign-in, the health
probes and /meta.

tags.name: meta
tags.description: Shared vocabulary: enums, grades and error codes

bearer.description: Sign in via POST /api/auth/login, then paste the accessToken here.

accessToken.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request.

status.description: Whether this dependency answered its probe.

responseTimeMs.description: Round-trip time of the probe, in milliseconds.

code.description: Stable error code when the dependency is down.

message.description: Actionable explanation of how to fix it.
message.example: Cannot reach PostgreSQL. Start it with "pnpm dev:infra" and confirm DATABASE_URL in your .env.

status.description: "ok" when every dependency is up; "degraded" when at least one is down. A degraded result is served with HTTP 503.

dependencies.description: One entry per checked dependency: "database", "queue" and "scheduler".

timezone.description: Timezone all scheduling dates and service windows are expressed in.

branchCodes.description: Branches. Staff may only serve work in their own branch — this is a hard rule.

weekdays.description: Weekday vocabulary used by allowed and preferred day rules.

pmsGradeLabels.description: Grades that satisfy the "every job needs at least one PMS-grade supervisor" rule.

frequencyUnits.description: Frequency units available on a service agreement.

errorCodes.description: Every stable error code the API can return. Clients must branch on these, never on message text.

skillLabel.description: Exactly as spelled in the workforce matrix.

gradeLabel.description: Exactly as spelled in the workforce matrix, typos included. Never parse this to decide seniority — use isPmsGrade.

isPmsGrade.description: Whether this person satisfies the "every job needs a PMS-grade supervisor" rule. Decided by the API from the grade; clients must not infer it from the label.

permanentSiteLabel.description: Set only for permanently stationed staff, who are never dispatched elsewhere.

canUsePublicTransport.description: Can reach a site by bus or other public transport, so a crew can be sent without a company vehicle.

authorizedVehicles.description: Vehicles this person may drive. Authorization only — nothing here implies ownership or a usual driver.

authorizedVehicleIds.description: Convenience list of the same vehicle ids, for filtering in the UI.

authorizedDriverCount.description: How many employees are authorised to drive it.

pmsSupervisorCount.description: Active PMS-grade supervisors. A branch with zero cannot be scheduled at all — every job needs one.

skillLabel.description: Exactly as spelled in the workforce matrix.

operatingHours.description: Opening windows. A weekday with no window is closed; several windows on one weekday mean the site shuts in between.

frequencyInterval.description: Units per cycle. 2 with WEEK is fortnightly; 3 with MONTH is quarterly.

frequencyLabel.description: The frequency written the way a manager would say it.

serviceWindowStartMinute.description: Narrows the site's hours. Null falls back to them entirely.

isActive.description: True only when status is ACTIVE.

currentVersion.description: Increments whenever a change would alter the visits produced.

allowedDays.description: Hard constraint. A visit never lands outside these weekdays.

preferredDays.description: Soft ranking preference. Always a subset of allowedDays.

snapshot.description: The agreement as it stood at this version — the scheduling-relevant fields only.

isPreferredDay.description: Fell on a preferred weekday, not merely an allowed one.

shortfalls.description: Periods that cannot hold the promised number of visits. Reported, never silently dropped.

requiresPmsSupervisor.description: Phase 1 requires a PMS-grade supervisor on every job.

isPreferredDay.description: Fell on a preferred weekday rather than a merely allowed one.
